linked_format_finding.canonical_emitter_rule: src/c2d_v6_entry.h accepts literal_count zero and rejects code_length zero; zero-literal executable entries are contractual.

linked_format_finding.root_cause: The C2-lite runtime entry reader treats a legitimate zero literal_count as an invalid record. The preceding transient-callability fix proved the high-edge bounds but had no execution fixture for a static, zero-literal callee.
linked_format_finding.not_transport_or_identity: The exact live entry row, generation, published entry count and line-1 boot are correct; no DMA, staging, catalog or product-identity mismatch is present.

recommended_class_c_cut.verification: Run a product-shaped WPLTO capacity probe and all C2-lite gates. Any promotable successor link and another hardware presmoke require the project's normal Class-C authorization.
